text:
deploy-bot: Canary deployment for release v2.3.1 started in us-west-2. 5% initial error rate threshold set at 20%

Mike: getting alerts — canary error climbed to ~28% over the last 10m, mostly 502/timeout.
Tina: saw that. Traffic pattern shows a spike in long tail latency for /generate endpoint.
Carlos: any relevant infra changes? no infra deploys in last hour except this canary.
Jen: the rollout policy is set to manual rollback for this shard due to DB migration flag.
Mike: hmm. auto-rollback would have reverted, but migration could leave partial state.
Tina: I agree we should avoid automated rollback if DB migration half-applied. Need coordinated rollback that runs db-migrate rollback first.
Carlos: do we have a safe rollback plan for the migration? I can run the reverse migration but need 2 approvals.
Mike: propose manual rollback of app pods to previous image then run migration rollback during quiet window. That keeps DB changes explicit.
Jen: +1. I'll coordinate the migration rollback with product to ensure no writes during the flip.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-1789 — Canary errors in us-west-2.
Mike: OK Carlos, execute app rollback to v2.3.0 now and pin routing to dedicated pool 3. Use `kubectl rollout undo` on canary ReplicaSet, then scale the new RS to match.
Carlos: running `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=12` now.
Carlos: rollback applied, new pods coming up. Health checks passing 2/3 so far.
Tina: starting a quick smoke test against /generate with sample prompt sets.
Tina: smoke looks good. 200s stable, tail latency back to previous baseline.
Mike: Jen, once you confirm migration rollback schedule, let's keep canary pinned to v2.3.0 and mark v2.3.1 blocked for re-release until root cause analysis.
Jen: scheduling migration rollback run at 16:30 UTC with product and data. I'll update the release notes and block re-rollout in the release tracker.
deploy-bot: Canary status changed -> rolled back. release-v2.3.1 flagged: blocked_until=RCA_COMPLETE.
Mike: thanks everyone. Quick follow-ups: Carlos will add a runbook step for safe migration-aware rollbacks, Tina will collect failing request traces, Jen will update release notes and block the release, and I'll file RCA.
Carlos: will add runbook PR in 30m.
Tina: exporting traces and request logs now, will attach to INC-2026-1789.
Jen: release tracker updated, note added to release notes: "v2.3.1 blocked after canary errors; manual rollback executed to v2.3.0; migration coordination required before re-release."
Mike: closing thread for exec updates — keep updates in INC ticket for RCA. :thumbsup:
